en: A sepia-toned portrait of a young man in a light-colored military-style uniform with shoulder boards, standing and facing the camera. The background is plain and softly faded, giving a studio-portrait look. Printed text appears along the bottom edge in Greek on the left and in French on the right, and there is a round seal or emblem at the lower left plus a website credit at the bottom center.
